example_english: Thank you very much for your help.

english_meaning: Youngest daughter (inheritor in matrilineal Khasi custom)
example_khasi: Ka khadnah ka kyntoit ïa ka ïing ka sem.
example_english: The youngest daughter takes care of the ancestral house.

english_meaning: Knowing one's maternal and paternal clan relations (foundational Khasi moral value)
example_khasi: U Khasi u bat skhem ïa ka tip kur tip kha.
example_english: The Khasi firmly holds to the moral knowledge of maternal and paternal lineage.

english_meaning: Earn righteousness / Live honestly (core Khasi ethical motto)
example_khasi: Dei ban kamai ïa ka hok ha ka jingim.
example_english: One must earn through righteousness in life.
